title: Sampling variability
outcome: Explain sampling variability using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Two small samples can differ. A fixed classifier is scored on two distinct four-case samples from a declared collection.
given: Sample A has 3 correct of 4; sample B has 2 correct of 4. The model and rubric are unchanged.

steps.label: Keep model fixed
steps.detail: No training or threshold change occurs between samples.

steps.label: Compute observed rates
steps.detail: A is 75%; B is 50%, differing by 25 percentage points.

steps.label: Consider sampling
steps.detail: Different included cases can change a small-sample rate.

explanation: Sampling variability means a statistic can vary because different units were observed. Do not automatically attribute every rate change to a model improvement or deterioration.

counterfactual.change: Evaluate the exact same fixed four cases twice with deterministic predictions.
counterfactual.prediction: The counts should agree unless some condition, data or scoring changed.
counterfactual.reason: The sampling explanation no longer applies when the records are identical.

student_task: Calculate the two four-case rates and their difference. Explain how changed included cases can affect a fixed model, and why identical deterministic records should not differ on a rerun.
teacher_answer: No training or threshold change occurs between samples. A is 75%; B is 50%, differing by 25 percentage points. Different included cases can change a small-sample rate. Changed case: The counts should agree unless some condition, data or scoring changed. The sampling explanation no longer applies when the records are identical.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: These two samples do not supply a probability model or confidence interval; none is invented.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
